item.title: Rules simulator - Rules simulator now supports Workers
item.description: Starting today, customers can use Rules simulator to confirm if a request to a specific URL within their zone is routed through a Workers script.

item.title: Rules simulator - Rules simulator now supports BYOIP zones
item.description: Customers can now use Rules simulator to simulate HTTP/S requests through their BYOIP zones.

item.title: Rules simulator - Rules simulator now supports grey-clouded hostnames
item.description: Even if the hostname is not proxied by Cloudflare, Rules simulator will now return all the configurations that Cloudflare would have applied to the request.
